build_soccer_ball: build a SoccerBall entity with custom radius, mass, friction, and damp_ratio parameters for MuJoCo simulation
create_regulation_soccer_ball: create a FIFA regulation size 5 soccer ball using the regulation_soccer_ball factory function
register_player_with_ball: register a player entity with the SoccerBall so it tracks ball-player contact events
review_SoccerBall_after_substep: review the SoccerBall after_substep method that detects contacts between the ball and registered players
summarize_SoccerBall_properties: summarize the SoccerBall hit, repossessed, intercepted, and dist_between_last_hits properties for contact tracking
